title: Generalized People Diversity: Learning a Human Perception-Aligned Diversity Representation for People Images

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating human perception of diversity through image triplet comparisons to determine if differences in perceived gender expression are weighted more heavily by annotators than skin tone differences.

Comparing the proposed generalized diversity representation against a narrow skin tone and gender expression baseline, and using human annotators to rate the relative diversity impact of skin tone versus other traits.

Conducting human perception case studies using image triplets to evaluate how culturally specific attire (e.g., hijabs, traditional cultural wedding dresses) impacts the perceived diversity of an image set.

bias_targets.target: General Sociocultural diversity (Age, Disability, Body shape, Sexual orientation)
bias_targets.methodology: Measuring end-to-end image ranking diversity using human annotators to evaluate the Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) results on the newly created Diverse People Dataset, which utilizes diversity-adding sub-queries for a wide range of demographic attributes.
